1: // Neon Runner – simple endless runner
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   // Full‑screen canvas
10:   const resize = () => {
11:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
12:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
13:   };
14:   resize();
15:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
16: 
17:   // Game constants
18:   const SHIP_SIZE = 30;
19:   const ORB_SIZE = 12;
20:   const BARRIER_WIDTH = 40;
21:   const BARRIER_HEIGHT = 120;
22:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
23:   const ORB_INTERVAL = 2000;
24:   const SPEED = 5;
25:   const GAME_TIME = 60; // seconds
26: 
27:   // State
28:   const ship = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height - SHIP_SIZE * 2, w: SHIP_SIZE, h: SHIP_SIZE };
29:   let obstacles = [];
30:   let orbs = [];
31:   let score = 0;
32:   let timeLeft = GAME_TIME;
33:   let lastSpawn = 0;
34:   let lastOrb = 0;
35:   let lastTick = performance.now();
36:   let gameOver = false;
37: 
38:   // Input handling
39:   const keys = {};
40:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
41:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
42: 
43:   const rectCollision = (a, b) =>
44:     a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
45: 
46:   const spawnBarrier = () => {
47:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - BARRIER_WIDTH);
48:     obstacles.push({ x, y: -BARRIER_HEIGHT, w: BARRIER_WIDTH, h: BARRIER_HEIGHT });
49:   };
50: 
51:   const spawnOrb = () => {
52:     const size = ORB_SIZE;
53:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - size);
54:     const y = -size;
55:     orbs.push({ x, y, w: size, h: size });
56:   };
57: 
58:   const update = (now) => {
59:     const dt = now - lastTick;
60:     lastTick = now;
61:     if (gameOver) return;
62: 
63:     // timer
64:     timeLeft -= dt / 1000;
65:     if (timeLeft <= 0) {
66:       timeLeft = 0;
67:       gameOver = true;
68:     }
69: 
70:     // move ship
71:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= SPEED;
72:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += SPEED;
73:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= SPEED;
74:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += SPEED;
75:     // keep inside canvas
76:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.w, ship.x));
77:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.h, ship.y));
78: 
79:     // spawn entities
80:     if (now - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
81:       spawnBarrier();
82:       lastSpawn = now;
83:     }
84:     if (now - lastOrb > ORB_INTERVAL) {
85:       spawnOrb();
86:       lastOrb = now;
87:     }
88: 
89:     // update obstacles/orbs
90:     const moveY = SPEED * (dt / 16);
91:     obstacles.forEach(o => (o.y += moveY));
92:     orbs.forEach(o => (o.y += moveY * 0.8));
93: 
94:     // collision detection
95:     for (const o of obstacles) {
96:       if (rectCollision(ship, o)) {
97:         gameOver = true;
98:         break;
99:       }
100:     }
101:     if (!gameOver) {
102:       // collect orbs
103:       orbs = orbs.filter(orb => {
104:         if (rectCollision(ship, orb)) {
105:           score += 10;
106:           return false;
107:         }
108:         // remove off‑screen
109:         return orb.y < canvas.height;
110:       });
111:     }
112:     // remove passed obstacles
113:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.y < canvas.height);
114: 
115:     draw();
116:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(update);
117:     else drawGameOver();
118:   };
119: 
120:   const draw = () => {
121:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
122:     // neon background grid
123:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#222';
124:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
125:     for (let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += 40) {
126:       ctx.beginPath();
127:       ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
128:       ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height);
129:       ctx.stroke();
130:     }
131:     for (let y = 0; y < canvas.height; y += 40) {
132:       ctx.beginPath();
133:       ctx.moveTo(0, y);
134:       ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y);
135:       ctx.stroke();
136:     }
137: 
138:     // ship – neon triangle
139:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
140:     ctx.beginPath();
141:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
142:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
143:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
144:     ctx.closePath();
145:     ctx.fill();
146: 
147:     // barriers – neon rectangles
148:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';
149:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
150:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
151:     });
152: 
153:     // orbs – neon circles
154:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
155:     orbs.forEach(o => {
156:       ctx.beginPath();
157:       ctx.arc(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2, o.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
158:       ctx.fill();
159:     });
160: 
161:     // UI
162:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
163:     ctx.font = '20px monospace';
164:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 20, 30);
165:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${Math.ceil(timeLeft)}`, 20, 60);
166:   };
167: 
168:   const drawGameOver = () => {
169:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
170:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
171:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
172:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
173:     ctx.font = '48px monospace';
174:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
175:     ctx.font = '32px monospace';
176:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
177:   };
178: 
179:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
180: })();
